description: The plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of a medium Whisper model with different amounts of weights. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The plot contains four lines representing different configurations. The solid green line with circle markers, representing "medium AdaLoRA_int4", starts at approximately 25.5 at epoch 0, rises slightly to 27 at epoch 1, and then steadily declines to roughly 11.2 at epoch 6. The solid green line with square markers, representing "medium AdaLoRA_int8", begins at roughly 25.5 at epoch 0, peaks at 28.5 at epoch 1, and decreases to approximately 15.2 at epoch 6. The dashed green line with circle markers, representing "medium int4", starts at approximately 29.6 at epoch 0, peaks at 36.2 at epoch 1, and then steadily declines to roughly 21.1 at epoch 6. The dashed green line with square markers, representing "medium int8", begins at roughly 29.6 at epoch 0, drops to 26.5 at epoch 1, rises slightly to 27.2 at epoch 2, and then decreases to approximately 15.4 at epoch 6.
